checkpoint_wire.active_host_interaction: complete closed vv-agent.host-interaction-request.v1 object including prompt or null; restored before wake after crash

public_entrypoints.durable_resume: repeat Runner.run with the same Agent, root input, and stable checkpoint key

deferred_pending_semantics: no cycle commit and no response result were returned by this delivery attempt

cycle_semantics.logical_cycle: the in-flight cycle being closed; for a claimed cycle it equals cycle_index + 1

ordinary_tool_receipt_semantics.result_digest: RFC 8785 canonical complete_tool_execution_result after strict typed-writer normalization followed by lowercase SHA-256
ordinary_tool_receipt_semantics.admit_deferred_batch_receipts: deferred-only; completed or already-receipted outcomes are rejected

response_recovery_resume_attempt.wire_value: authoritative value before the combined recovery claim
response_recovery_resume_attempt.successful_claim: increment exactly once; consumed event and next envelope use the incremented value

host_interaction_notification_ambiguity.reaper: retry pending or expired claimed; route ambiguous to explicit reconciliation; retain aborted as terminal audit
